concerns.text: Principle II (Verified Accuracy) is marked PASS, but the accompanying research.md lists several core data sources (historical & recent GBIF/eBird occurrences, WorldClim rasters) as having “No verified source – open API used”. This contradicts the constitution requirement that every external citation be verified.

The plan states that model files are saved under `models/*.pkl` but does not reference the `contracts/model_artifact.schema.yaml` for validation. Consequently, the contract for ModelArtifact is never exercised.

The preprocessing step mentions validation of `logs/preprocess_counts.yaml` against `contracts/log_counts.schema.yaml` but does not mention validation of the raw occurrence CSVs against `contracts/occurrence.schema.yaml` or the processed feature CSV against `contracts/occurrence_record.schema.yaml`.
The plan describes downloading climate rasters but never references the `contracts/climate_raster.schema.yaml` that defines required metadata (e.g., raster_id, checksum_sha256).
